# src

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `components/gate-account-feature-reading-rendering-place`: Gate an account feature by reading `useAuthState().needsSignIn` and rendering `SignInPrompt` in place of THAT feature - never block the app and never grow an app-wide gate. There is no login wall, ever, and an offline build with no backend configured must grow zero auth UI.
- **invariant** `export/validate-output-target-before-export-publish`: Validate output for its target before export or publish, and block invalid output. Compatibility is NoaCG's job, never something generated content is trusted to get right.
- **invariant** `model/bind-browser-local-library-account-every`: Bind the browser's local library to ONE account: every account that signs in keeps its documents under its own key names from `model/accountScope.ts`, only the library in use is loaded, and sync runs only while that library is the signed-in account's own. Signing in adopts the signed-out workspace, merges it through the cloud, or switches with a reload, and a deliberate sign-out returns to the signed-out workspace. Never re-mint a record the cloud refused for another account - that copies one account's work into another's.
- **invariant** `model/holds-canonical-air-legibility-rules-owner`: `designRules.ts` holds the CANONICAL on-air legibility rules: the owner's size table (role by standard or safe mode by viewing profile, as a share of the frame's short side), the weight, stroke, safe-area and contrast floors, and the prompt blocks GENERATED from those constants. Prompting, the spike instruments and the product validator's warn-first checks in `validation/designRulesWarnings.ts` all READ this module; nothing copies a number out of it. The maths is pinned by `scripts/design-rules.test.mjs`. Extend it additively.
- **invariant** `model/never-rename-persisted-deployed-identifiers-storage`: Never rename persisted or deployed identifiers: the `spx-gfx-*` storage keys, BroadcastChannel names, CSS class prefixes, and the Supabase and Vercel project slugs. Renaming one wipes saved user data or breaks a deploy; only displayed names change.
- **invariant** `root/keep-generated-template-self-contained-runtime`: Keep a generated template self-contained: no runtime dependencies and no CDN references, relative paths only in exports. GSAP and the Lottie player are bundled locally and the player is injected only when a template uses a Lottie asset.
- **invariant** `root/never-treat-playout-client-word-general`: Never treat a playout client as the word for a general concept: it is one TARGET among others. A slot is `logo: optional` with a default logo, never built-in. `check:client-neutral` is the gate. OGraf is the long-term interoperability standard NoaCG follows, not a declared internal format.
- **invariant** `root/version-every-persisted-format-ship-breaking`: Version every persisted format, and ship a breaking change together with its migration in the same commit. Additive optional fields never bump the version; a breaking change bumps it and migrates ON READ so everything downstream sees one shape; serialization always writes the current version; an unknown version degrades to read-only rather than crashing.
- **invariant** `wizard/give-every-wizard-step-own-history`: Give every wizard step its own history entry at `#/new/step/<name>`, NAMED and never indexed, because import mode adds a step that shifts every later index. Step 0 carries no segment, so Back off the front page still leaves, and the open reset seeds its step from the route rather than from 0.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-three-rules-svg-reader-load`: Keep three rules in the SVG reader load-bearing: a `<tspan>` is a LINE or a KERNED RUN and only the measured GAP tells them apart; hidden layers and `<defs>` or `<symbol>` text are never offered; and outline rows are RANKED by whether the shapes read as type, never filtered out.
- **invariant** `wizard/make-mapsvgfieldsstep-mapping-step-mode-over`: Make MapSvgFieldsStep the one mapping step in `svg` mode, over text layers, pictures and OUTLINED-TEXT rows, with a ticked glyph group hidden and a placed line standing in - its box MEASURED on the step own inline render and never the preview iframe. Lead the drop step with the SVG export help ABOVE the zone: nothing below the gesture target is read.
- **invariant** `wizard/report-what-measured-result-card-verdict`: Report what was MEASURED on the result card, not a verdict: group existing findings into the operator-facing rows and add no checks of your own, so a row can honestly read "not played, so not tested" on the one-shot path. Show verbatim any rule no row claims, never swallow it.
- **trap** `ai/answer-kind-question-identity-against-resolved`: Answer the KIND question by IDENTITY against the resolved chassis, and report only when BOTH sides are known.
- **trap** `ai/measure-parts-check-driving-every-text`: Measure the parts check by DRIVING every text-bearing field to a sentinel and re-reading the painted frame, never by reading the markup for field ids. Ignore opacity while doing it.
- **trap** `root/keep-app-declaration-matching-meta-preview`: Keep the app `color-scheme: dark` declaration and the matching meta the preview injects into its srcdoc PAIRED.
- **trap** `root/keep-boot-watchdog-connection-check-working`: Keep the `/app` boot watchdog and connection check working: `?diag=1` renders the inline diagnostics with main.tsx standing down, durable-store hydration times out to localStorage, and a boot that never mounts paints a plain-HTML diagnosis.
- **trap** `wizard/hide-closed-author-rule-because-browser`: Hide a closed `<details>` with an author rule - `details:not([open]) > *:not(summary) { display: none }` - because the browser own `display: none` on non-summary children loses to ANY author `display`, and the Style step disclosures wrap a flex row. Assert measured HEIGHT is 0 in specs, never the `open` attribute.
- **trap** `wizard/take-shape-size-where-painted-never`: Take a shape size from where it is PAINTED, never from its attributes: apply every transform down the ancestor chain when building the inventory.
- **trap** `wizard/use-file-chip-class-filename-never`: Use `.wz-file-chip` for a filename, never `.wz-fid`, the fixed-width field-id badge.
- **rule** `root/add-playwright-spec-any-new-flow`: Add a Playwright spec for any new UI flow, plus its mapping, in the same commit.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-browse-disclosure-every-width-closed`: Keep ONE Browse disclosure at every width, closed by default, carrying its active count. Lead the step with search, the type select and the style families; put programme, field counts, structures, capabilities and motion behind the toggle. The LEAD ROW is a GRID of two lines - select and Filters, then the chips - never one wrapping flex line.
- **rule** `wizard/lay-wizard-out-after-entry-rail`: Lay the wizard out after Entry as rail, form column, preview. Entry itself is a card menu with no creation-step navigation, and the rail appears the moment a card is chosen. Keep the FOOTER in the form column so Next sits under the form it advances, not under the graphic beside it.
- **rule** `wizard/let-odd-last-entry-card-span`: Let an odd last entry card span the row through `.wz-entry-card:last-child:nth-child(odd)` and size to its OWN copy. The row-alignment reserve is two empty lines on a card that has no row-mate.
- **rule** `wizard/open-text-step-fields-already-placed`: Open the Text step with fields already placed where the artwork has an empty panel, deterministically and with no model call, ONCE and only into an empty step. Re-running is the reader explicit act, and artwork with no flat panel refuses OUT LOUD while the manual tools stand unchanged.
- **rule** `wizard/propose-brand-never-apply-strip-offers`: PROPOSE brand, never apply it: the strip offers colours read out of the first uploaded image by deterministic arithmetic with no model call, plus the install saved looks. Both write the spec brand colours, which the existing lock already honours over anything the AI picks, and the pick stays the user.
- **rule** `wizard/state-amber-hover-every-wizard-shell`: State the amber hover for every wizard-shell control ONCE, over `.wz-header` and `.wz-dot`, never per button.
